verdict.rationale: Rootly documents alert ingestion from monitoring tools such as Datadog, PagerDuty, and Sentry, as well as email alert sources. Its Alert Routes send incoming alerts to teams, services, and escalation policies based on user-defined conditions, which can evaluate alert sources, normalized fields, and raw-payload JSONPath values. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of routing behavior, and a fuller catalog of supported alert-source integrations in the evidence.

support.subject: As an SRE, alerts from my monitoring tools are ingested through documented sources and routed to the right team by conditions I define

citations.quote: Use Alert Routes to determine which teams, services, and escalation policies receive incoming alerts from your monitoring tools based on conditions you define.
Alerts arrive programmatically from monitoring tools like Datadog, PagerDuty, or Sentry... Rootly deduplicates repeats, groups related alerts together, routes each one to the right team
It supports evaluation against: Alert Sources, Alert Fields (normalized metadata), Raw payload values (JSONPath), Teams, services, and escalation policies
Rootly provides a unified routing layer that works across all alert sources, enabling consistent on-call workflows.
